sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This language module is intended for students with no previous knowledge of the Spanish language and will introduce the very basics of Spanish language and cultures at foundational level. The module aims to provide students with an exploratory, first look into the very basic grammatical structures of the language and elementary skills in all four key language skills: writing, speaking, listening and reading, while introducing the culture, customs and society of the Spanish-speaking countries, helping students develop a preliminary awareness of the cultural and social background of the language.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Demonstrate understanding of very simple and familiar Spanish words, phrases and expressions when spoken slowly and clearly. B Demonstrate comprehension of very simple and familiar words, phrases and short sentences in written Spanish. C Communicate basic personal information and take part in very simple oral exchanges in Spanish. D Produce very basic written texts in Spanish about familiar topics. E Identify very basic features s of the culture of Spanish-speaking countries.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Core teaching takes place through Spanish language and study skills workshops, with an emphasis on interaction among students as well as between students and Artificial Intelligence (AI), and on the active participation of all learners, both inside and outside the classroom, through blended learning activities. In addition, guided reading and directed study will be carried out so that students can prepare for classes, reinforce content, and develop autonomous learning strategies with the support of AI (for example, through linguistic correction tools which also provide feedback, personalized exercise generation, or conversation assistants). Likewise, online resources will be used alongside AI applications to complement face-to-face sessions and workshops, facilitating access to additional materials and immediate feedback.
